remarks:
Located just a few steps off of Whirlpool St. and the beautiful gorge, we have 15 vacant lots zoned R3-B perfect for the development of multi family homes and short terms rentals(Air bnbs). The lots are mostly together, level and make up about 2.10 acres. Utilities are at the street for convenience. Some lots previously had homes on them that were removed. This location is just great and so is the price! A lot of opportunities here!       Tax ID: Address: total acreage:
